decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that records the LED type, freelancer selection of compatible LEDs, visual effect, and social-media context.
Selecting suitable LEDs supplements the component set but does not necessarily change the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
The request to select setup-compatible LEDs does not explicitly revise the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
The LED selection and base-aesthetic direction do not alter the whisk configuration or its cleaning and rotation criteria.
Choosing suitable compatible LEDs is consistent with the existing sourcing policy and does not change that policy.
Decorative LEDs and base appearance do not affect the requirement for splash-free mixing.
The source does not change access to internal systems or any maintenance and serviceability behavior.
The LED and base-aesthetic decisions leave bowl removal, swapping, and cleaning access unchanged.
Although the source requests extra visual details, it does not change any logo, wording, font, placard, or branding value.
The client does not accept the proposed replacement for the on/off switch, and that proposal concerns a power control rather than the existing press-to-dispense interaction.
The source changes decorative component selection and base appearance, not spout geometry, construction, orientation, or pour direction.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the visible base as a creative focal point, the flash-and-pizazz objective, and the social-media context.
